mapper.select: SELECT ()::text FROM integration.if_delivery d JOIN integration.if_request r ON r.id=d.request_key WHERE d.interface_id=#{interfaceId} AND d.source_system=#{source} AND d.request_id=#{requestId} AND d.scope=#{scope}
SELECT ()::text FROM integration.if_delivery d JOIN integration.if_request r ON r.id=d.request_key WHERE d.request_key=CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
SELECT ()::text FROM integration.if_delivery d JOIN integration.if_request r ON r.id=d.request_key WHERE d.request_key=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) FOR UPDATE OF d

SELECT request_key::text FROM ( SELECT request_key,next_at AS due_at FROM integration.if_delivery WHERE state='WAIT' AND next_at <= statement_timestamp() UNION ALL SELECT request_key,lease_until AS due_at FROM integration.if_delivery WHERE state='LEASED' AND lease_until <= statement_timestamp() ) due ORDER BY due_at,request_key LIMIT 20

SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',d.request_key,'requestId',r.request_id,'traceId',r.trace_id,'interfaceId',r.interface_id,'status',r.status,'state',d.state,'attempts',d.attempts,'maxAttempts',d.max_attempts,'nextAt',d.next_at,'leaseUntil',d.lease_until,'errorCode',d.last_error,'canRetry',d.state IN ('DONE','DEAD_LETTER') AND d.retryable AND d.attempts < 10)::text FROM integration.if_delivery d JOIN integration.if_request r ON r.id=d.request_key ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE integration.if_delivery SET state='LEASED',attempts=attempts+1,lease_token=CAST(#{token} AS uuid),lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds' WHERE request_key=CAST(#{id} AS uuid)

UPDATE integration.if_request SET status='SENDING',attempt_id=CAST(#{attempt} AS uuid),processing_stage='REQUEST_DISPATCHED',updated_at=now() WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND status IN ('READY','FAILED','UNKNOWN')
UPDATE integration.if_request SET status='UNKNOWN',error_code='LEASE_EXPIRED',updated_at=now() WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND status='SENDING'
UPDATE integration.if_attempt SET status='UNKNOWN',error_code='LEASE_EXPIRED',completed_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE request_key=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND status='SENDING'

UPDATE integration.if_delivery SET state=#{state},retryable=#{retryable},last_error=#{error},lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_at=clock_timestamp()+#{delay}*interval '1 millisecond' WHERE request_key=CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
UPDATE integration.if_delivery SET state='WAIT',max_attempts=attempts+1,next_at=clock_timestamp(),lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE request_key=CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
